text:
ana-partnerships: Heads up 1: SEA Gateway (APAC distributor) is rejecting marketplace POs for TE-RACK-MINI and TE-RACK-XL unless the PO includes a Country of Origin (COO) code and a notarized Customs Declaration reference. Their inbound EDI parser expects an extra segment (X-COO) that our feed doesn't emit.

marco-ops: Do we know which EDI message type? 850? 810?

ana-partnerships: It's in the 850 PO. They expect a custom segment after N1:```
X-COO|US|DOCREF:CD-2026-998
```

tom-procurement: Our marketplace EDI currently sticks to the canonical 850 fields. Adding vendor-specific segments is supported by the pipeline but only via a vendor-mapping table. That mapping isn't in place for SEA Gateway.

riley-sales: SEA Gateway says their warehouse won't release hardware without the notarized ref in the PO. This is blocking two pending customer orders in APAC. Customer impact: potential ship delay 5-7 business days.

marco-ops: Short-term ideas: (1) inject X-COO via vendor-mapping (fast, needs vendor entry), (2) email notarized doc + PO number (vendor refuses that format), (3) create a dummy PO line SKU "COO-DOC" referencing a file URL (hacky).

dee-legal: Legal: if we introduce a custom EDI segment, we should add a non-amendment note so attachments/segments can't be construed as changing the contract. Also confirm whether notarized doc storage meets export control regimes. I'll check export-control counsel.

tom-procurement: Mapping route estimate: 3 business days to add vendor-mapping + QA, then we can emit X-COO for new POs. But existing POs will need re-transmission (manual).

riley-sales: Can we ask SEA Gateway to accept a re-transmit of active POs with the X-COO appended? They might accept but need confirmation. I'll ping their liaison.

fulfill-bot: Automated: PO 2026-11-02-SG-881 created (status: pending). Related SKUs: TE-RACK-XL x2.

ana-partnerships: If vendor mapping is 3 days, can we prioritize re-transmit for the two impacted POs only? Procurement: will that cause reconciliation mismatches if we resend with different EDI payload?

tom-procurement: There is a reconciliation risk, but we can set a reconciliation tag (field REISSUE:true) so downstream finance ignores duplicate matching for these order numbers. It requires a small update to the invoice matcher rules. That takes 1 dev day.

marco-ops: Ops note 1: re-transmit approach needs vendor sign-off to accept an updated payload referencing same PO number. Without their explicit ack the warehouse might treat it as duplicate.

riley-sales: Update: vendor liaison says they'll accept a corrected 850 if it includes X-COO and is marked as "REISSUE". They asked for the notarized doc to be uploaded to a secure FTP and referenced in the segment: `DOCREF:CD-2026-998`.

dee-legal: ok I'll review retention language and draft the non-amendment clause. Also confirm whether referencing the FTP object is sufficient vs attaching content inline.

ana-partnerships: Plan: (A) procurement opens vendor-mapping ticket and flags as P0, (B) ops re-transmit the two impacted POs with X-COO + REISSUE tag after vendor ack, (C) legal drafts protective clause and confirms storage retention. If any of these fail by EOD Friday we fall back to "COO-DOC" line workaround and manual fulfillment hold with customer comms.

marco-ops: tagging @oncall-fulfillment to monitor re-transmit job.

riley-sales: I'll update the affected customers with the contingency plan.

ana-partnerships: thanks team. Keeping this thread as the source of truth.
